log.asked:
Task: Plan moving day. Boxes must be packed before they can be loaded, and the van must be booked before anything can be loaded into it. We drive off once the boxes are in the van. The key has to go back to the landlord before we drive off, or we lose the deposit; once we have driven off it is too late to hand it back.

Things and states to use:
  van: not booked, booked, driven off
  deposit: held, back, lost
  boxes: unpacked, packed, in van
Events to use: pack, book van, load, return key, drive

The checker will test your model on these jobs:
- "the whole plan": events in order: pack, then book van, then load, then return key, then drive; expected at the end: van is driven off and deposit is back.
- "forgot the key": events in order: pack, then book van, then load, then drive; expected at the end: deposit is lost.
- "loading before packing": events in order: book van, then load, then pack, then drive; expected at the end: boxes is packed and van is booked.
- "nothing done": no events; expected at the end: deposit is held.

Here is a model for this task. It may contain mistakes, including mistakes the jobs above do not catch.

{"things":{"boxes":["unpacked","packed","in van"],"van":["not booked","booked","driven off"],"key":["with us","returned"],"deposit":["held","back","lost"]},"events":["pack","book van","load","return key","drive"],"start":{"boxes":"unpacked","van":"not booked","key":"with us","deposit":"held"},"rules":[{"name":"packing","when":["pack happens","boxes is unpacked"],"then":"boxes is packed","made_by":"guesser first guess"},{"name":"booking","when":["boxes is unpacked","van is not booked"],"then":"van is booked","made_by":"guesser first guess"},{"name":"loading","when":["load happens","boxes is packed","van is booked"],"then":"boxes is in van","made_by":"guesser first guess"},{"name":"driving","when":["drive happens","boxes is in van","van is booked"],"then":"van is driven off","made_by":"guesser first guess"},{"name":"returning the key","when":["return key happens","van is not driven off"],"then":"key is returned","made_by":"guesser first guess"},{"name":"deposit back","when":["van is driven off","key is returned","deposit is held"],"then":"deposit is back","made_by":"guesser first guess"},{"name":"deposit lost","when":["van is driven off","key is with us","deposit is held"],"then":"deposit is lost","made_by":"guesser first guess"}]}

Go through the task sentence by sentence and check that every part of it is in the model, and that every rule does what the task says, in every situation the task describes, not only in the jobs. Correct every mistake you find. Write the whole corrected model. If you find no mistake, write it unchanged.
